TEST_DEFINITIONS.description: Tata AIA uses explicit test lists per grid cell, not M-codes. Below are the test abbreviations used in the medical grid.

test_abbreviations.MER: Medical Examination Report — standard physical examination by doctor
test_abbreviations.BPB: Basic Pathology Battery (Non-Fasting) — includes RBS, HIV, Cholesterol, Triglycerides, Serum Creatinine, HDL, S Bilirubin, HBsAg, SGOT, SGPT, Alk Phosphates, Gamma GT, Albumin, BUN
test_abbreviations.BPB-F: Basic Pathology Battery (Fasting) — includes FBS, HIV, Cholesterol, Triglycerides, Serum Creatinine, HDL, S Bilirubin, HBsAg, SGOT, SGPT, Alk Phosphates, Gamma GT, Albumin, BUN
test_abbreviations.PSA: Prostate-Specific Antigen — male cancer screening (applicable for males >55 years irrespective of SA; for cover >25Cr part of tumor markers irrespective of age)
test_abbreviations.Urine Microalbumin: Urine microalbumin test for kidney function
test_abbreviations.Urine Cotinine: Urine cotinine test — required only for declared Non-Smoker applicants or those abstained from smoking for 24 months
test_abbreviations.Fundoscopy: Eye examination — only for age >50 or diabetic applicants

special_rules: Urine cotinine is required only for declared Non-Smoker applicants or those who have abstained from smoking for 24 months.
PSA applicable for all male lives aged above 55 irrespective of sum assured.
For cover >25Cr, PSA will be part of Tumor Marker test irrespective of age.
Live photo must be clicked at time of medicals for all cases.
Fundoscopy applicable only for age >50 or diabetic applicants.

REPLACEMENT_COVER.description: Replacement cover for existing insurance with other companies
conditions: Existing cover must be disclosed upfront with status (in force, surrendered, lapsed, under process).
Replacement only from/after date of policy anniversary or premium due date.
Affidavit on plain paper for replacement up to 10Cr, on 100 stamp paper for above 10Cr.

BUSINESS_INSURANCE.description: Business Insurance — Keyperson / Keyman, Partnership, Employer-Employee, HUF
BUSINESS_INSURANCE.allowed_plans: Term plan under Keyperson/Keyman Insurance, Partnership Insurance, Employer-Employee Schemes, HUF Cover on Karta
BUSINESS_INSURANCE.keyman_partnership_cover: Only Basic Death Cover (Life Option). Riders not allowed except TTI.
BUSINESS_INSURANCE.employer_employee_huf: Only Non-ROP option. LSPO & Top Up not available.

keyman_cover.financial_assessment: Lower of: a) Avg Directors remuneration/Salary x 10, OR b) Avg Gross profit x 3 x shareholding, OR c) Avg Net profit after tax + 30% Avg Depreciation x 5 x shareholding minus existing Keyperson cover
keyman_cover.max_tenure: 65 years (cap INR 100Cr). Extended to 75 for family-owned companies with affidavit.
keyman_cover.loss_rule: If company incurred losses in latest year or last two years, no KMI cover

partnership_cover.financial_assessment: Lower of: a) Avg Gross profit x 3 x shareholding, OR b) Avg Net profit after tax + 30% Avg Depreciation x 5 x shareholding minus existing partnership cover
requirements: Audited business financials (BS, P&L) for last 3 years

employer_employee.financial_assessment: Latest 2 years salary income from standard income proof x age income multiple. If stakeholder in proposing firm, can add: Avg 3yr Net profit after tax x shareholding.

LSPO_BENEFIT.description: Life Stage Plus Option — allows SA increase at life events
notes: Cannot exercise post Terminal Illness benefit execution.
Base plan SAR/DB considered as sum at risk for the policy.
Additional SA for LSPO not calculated at underwriting stage.
UW of LSPO done when customer exercises the benefit.
If exercised at reinstatement, subject to underwriting.
